CLI python -m mymlfw cloud launch --project NAME --role primary --gpu T4 --command CMD --idle-kill 30 --max-runtime 120 --ledger ledger/experiments.csv --experiment-id ID --baseline-id BASE --variable NAME --band-low 0 --band-high 1 --out cloud/rendered.sh
from mymlfw.cloud import JobSpec, render_launch
from mymlfw.sanitize import guard_row, prepare_frame
from mymlfw.paths import resolve_data_dir

DO NOT write custom GroupKFold loops; call mymlfw.cv.run_oof.
DO NOT fit feature clusters on the held-out fold.
DO NOT fit temperature on the fold being scored.
DO NOT add raw logits; convert with log_softmax before a probability pool.
DO NOT drop a branch unless on_mismatch="drop_and_warn".
DO NOT import mymlfw.train.lora from an engine.
DO NOT put weights in the notebook payload.
DO NOT enable kernel internet.
DO NOT register a second variable in one probe.
DO NOT launch cloud without CLOUD_APPROVAL.

<!-- mymlfw-index -->
recipe benchmark: items.jsonl plus a scorer callable.
recipe circuit-portfolio: Verified portfolio and receipt hashes.
recipe closed-set-llm-id: Shrunk TwinHead, log-linear blend, and a class-bias prior.
recipe code-agent: Two-stage LoRA, syntax and exec rewards, zip bundle.
recipe grouped-text: Text and a group column with no class-count floor.
recipe ranking: Ranked channels, MRR, one variable per probe.
<!-- /mymlfw-index -->
